title: The strict-local base-change mate is invertible on the closed stalk
statement: Let f:X→S be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and s:Spec Ω→S a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let A be a henselian local ring with separably closed residue field κA [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and let eA:Spec A≅strictHenselizationScheme(s) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Put jA=eA.hom followed by strictHenselizationStructuralMap(s) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Choose p0:X0→X and f0:X0→Spec A making a cartesian square over f,jA [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let k be any separably closed field and a:Spec k→Spec κA, and put t=a followed by the residue closed-point map Spec κA→Spec A. For any abelian étale sheaf G on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and q∈ℕ, let K=G[0]. The map on the geometric stalk at t [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] induced by H^q of the derived base-change mate D(jA)Rf_*K→Rf0_*D(p0)K [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange, def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is invertible. This assertion is about the one cartesian square over the strict-local structural map; there is no further cube or inverse image.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 03Q9 (theorem-higher-direct-images, canonical restriction of injective section complexes) and Tag 03QO (lemma-cohomology-strictly-henselian, global sections as the closed-point stalk). Online text at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03Q9 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QO read by P2 on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Compose eA with Scheme.Spec.mapIso (smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso s).symm.op to obtain e : Spec A ≅ strictLocalization s. The existing smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso_toBase equation identifies e.hom ≫ strictLocalizationToBase s with eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s. Transport the bottom morphism of the cartesian square by this equality and apply the fully proved adopted closed-stalk theorem to f, s, e, p₀, f₀, the same square, a, G and q. Proof irrelevance identifies the commutativity proofs in derivedBaseChangeMapPlus. No point, sheaf, degree, or square leg changes; the conclusion is exactly the original small-model stalk map.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q9 and 03QO; canonical small-to-full model transport of the already proved adopted closed-stalk theorem.

theorem smallModel_isIso_strictHenselization_baseChange_closedStalk
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [HenselianLocalRing A]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (eA : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
    {X₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : X₀ ⟶ X) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (sq₀ : IsPullback p₀ f₀ f (eA.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    (a : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((pointSmallEtale
      (a ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A)))).sheafFiber.map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
          ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq₀.toCommSq).app
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))))
